title: Search indexer settings
description: The whole 'indexer' state document (/config/indexer.json): which model profile embeds knowledge pages for search, and at what dimension. Indexing status is reported separately in /knowledge/indexer.json.

profile.description: Name of an embeddings deployment profile in /config/profile.json (e.g. 'embeddings'). Empty disables indexing.

dimensions.description: Embedding vector size. Changing it (or the profile's deployment) rebuilds the whole index.

min_similarity.description: Search cut-off: a page is returned only if it matches the query by keyword or its cosine similarity is at least this (0-1). Lower shows more loosely related pages; higher shows fewer. Changing it does not reindex.
